original_test_intent: Verify every expected PVDDIO_P0 through PN _C sensor is mapped to the correct I/O rail/VR phase or domain and reports human-readable current, status and thresholds matching the approved I/O electrical specification.
original_method: Resolve PVDDIO, P-index and C semantics, enumerate all expected I/O rail-current channels and immutable raw/UI identities, collect complete value/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized I/O voltage, power/activity and VR health/temperature context, and compare each result to the owner contract without changing load, sequencing or electrical state.
manual_activity: The owner defines PVDDIO/P/C semantics, I/O rail topology, current scaling/limits and context tolerances; an operator verifies raw/UI identity and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: PVDDIO P0..PN/C definition and physical rail/phase/domain to SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Current unit/scale, normal range, warning/critical thresholds and sampling specification
Read-only associated I/O voltage, power/activity and VR health/temperature context
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never change I/O voltage, workload, link/power state, sequencing, VR settings, current limits or thresholds
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind every reading to its I/O rail/phase/domain with synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overcurrent/undercurrent, I/O/VR/thermal fault, impossible unit/value, missing/duplicate mapping or BMC error
Do not retry after applying I/O load or changing rail state
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the complete PVDDIO P-series current population and mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only I/O/VR context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/scale normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, mapping or raw/UI/context/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no electrical/I/O stimulus or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define PVDDIO/P/C semantics and supply authoritative I/O rail/VR map and limits
Review I/O/VR health, electrical plausibility and raw/UI discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may expose records, but a literal PVDDIO_P0~N_C name and head-limited fallback cannot define vendor semantics, prove every I/O P channel, physical rail/VR mapping, complete thresholds, UI presentation or I/O context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner mapping, securely enumerate the complete SDR/Redfish inventory, select all PVDDIO P-series current records, capture full read-only metadata and synchronized I/O voltage/power/activity/VR context, then correlate WebUI rows to the electrical specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PVDDIO_P0~N_C scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-P-index matrix containing I/O rail/VR phase/domain identity and C meaning, raw current/unit/status/threshold, I/O voltage/power/activity/VR health/thermal context and UI display.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact I/O electrical topology and passive plausibility while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and workload/rail manipulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One current-like value cannot prove PVDDIO/P/C semantics or cover P0..PN. Every expected mapped I/O rail channel and threshold must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PVDDIO may power multiple controllers or external interfaces whose activity is not captured by CPU/SOC telemetry; only the board power-domain map defines relevant context.

project_override_considerations: If P indices represent phases or I/O islands disabled/combined by configuration, the owner must define expected population and balancing semantics; SOC or CPU rail evidence cannot fill PVDDIO coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/I/O-domain/VR electrical spec revision
PVDDIO/P/C definition and per-channel rail/phase/domain to raw/UI identity matrix
Complete current/unit/status/threshold/entity/timestamp plus I/O voltage/power/activity/VR health/thermal context
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved scale/sampling/plausibility comparison
Per-channel discrepancies, no-stimulus/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently request PVDDIO P-series sensor validation. Vendor rail/index/suffix semantics are missing project inputs, not contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: I/O rail/VR semantics and mapping, electrical specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Defines the I/O-domain electrical identity and context separately from SOC/CPU rails and requires complete passive per-channel evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: PVDDIO cannot be inferred from SOC or CPU current because it may serve separate controllers, links or board devices with independent activity and sequencing. P-index and suffix semantics must come from the project topology. A plausible current requires aligned voltage, activity, power and VR-health context for that I/O domain. Passive collection is essential because changing an I/O rail or sequence can disrupt multiple subsystems beyond this sensor review.
